stories.title: Notícia falsa sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida viraliza nas redes com críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: False story about Our Lady of Aparecida goes viral on social media with criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: A fabricated report that presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patroness spread widely on social networks, causing negative repercussions for the candidate.

stories.title: 'Proibir não é proteger': associações se posicionam contra a MP de Lula que proíbe bets no Brasil

en.title: 'Banning is not protecting': gaming associations position themselves against Lula's measure that prohibits betting in Brazil
en.summary: The Brazilian government announced stricter regulations on sports betting, prompting gaming associations to oppose the provisional measure, arguing that prohibition would not eliminate the practice but could drive bettors to illegal sites.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘Lula tenta fazer estelionato antes da eleição’ ao proibir bets no País

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says that 'Lula tries to commit fraud before the election' by prohibiting betting in the country
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the government's betting prohibition measure, characterizing it as fraudulent election-related action.

stories.title: Mendonça manda derrubar posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a tirar ‘padroeira’ de N. S. Aparecida

en.title: Mendonça orders removal of posts about false support from Flávio for removing 'patroness' of Our Lady of Aparecida
en.summary: Minister Mendonça issued orders to take down social media posts spreading misinformation about Flávio Bolsonaro's alleged position regarding Our Lady of Aparecida's patroness title.

stories.title: Quaest em AL: Lula, 44%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 32%

en.title: Quaest in AL: Lula, 44%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 32%
en.summary: A Quaest poll shows voting intentions for the presidential first round among Alagoas voters, with Lula at 44% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 32%, while other candidates receive lower support.

stories.title: Bets viram as vilãs da eleição e alvo fácil para Lula; veja vídeo

en.title: Betting sites become villains of the election and easy target for Lula; see video
en.summary: Betting companies have become a major focus of criticism during the election campaign and are being targeted by President Lula as a central campaign issue.

stories.title: Governo Lula proíbe bets e manda sites devolverem saldo de apostadores até 1 dia depois da eleição

en.title: Lula government bans bets and orders sites to return bettor balances within 1 day after the election
en.summary: The Lula administration has prohibited betting operations and mandated that online betting platforms return customer funds within one day following the election.

stories.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro lidera em SP e RJ, Lula fica à frente em PE, e MG tem empate

en.title: Datafolha: Flávio Bolsonaro leads in SP and RJ, Lula ahead in PE, and MG is tied
en.summary: According to a Datafolha poll, Flávio Bolsonaro leads in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, Lula leads in Pernambuco, and the race is tied in Minas Gerais.

stories.title: Janja publica foto de Lula com Nossa Senhora após desgaste de Flávio com boato sobre santa

en.title: Janja publishes photo of Lula with Our Lady after damage to Flávio over rumor about saint
en.summary: Brazil's First Lady published a photograph of President Lula holding an image of Our Lady of Aparecida following rumors that Flávio Bolsonaro intended to remove the saint's status as Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sobre MP das bets: Lula tenta fazer estelionato antes da eleição

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro on betting regulation: Lula attempts electoral fraud before election
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the government's planned temporary measure to ban betting services in Brazil, accusing President Lula of electoral fraud ahead of the upcoming election.

stories.title: Mendonça manda derrubar postagens sobre Flávio e Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Mendonça orders removal of posts about Flávio and Our Lady of Aparecida
en.summary: Electoral tribunal vice-president André Mendonça directed Meta, X, TikTok, and YouTube to remove content associating presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro with efforts to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of her patroness status, which Bolsonaro has denied.

stories.title: Alckmin defende tradições católicas após boato contra Flávio sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Alckmin defends Catholic traditions after rumor against Flávio about Our Lady of Aparecida
en.summary: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that religious traditions will be protected and defended Catholic practices on social media, citing messages received from concerned Catholics.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado federal em Goiás (GO): veja a lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Federal deputy candidates in Goiás (GO): see the updated list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Goiás has 265 registered candidates for federal deputy positions competing in the 2026 elections. The first round of voting is scheduled for October 4, with 5,080,755 eligible voters and 17 available seats in the Chamber of Deputies.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado federal no Maranhão (MA): veja a lista atualizada das eleições 2026

en.title: Federal deputy candidates in Maranhão (MA): see the updated list for 2026 elections
en.summary: Maranhão has 282 registered candidates for federal deputy positions competing in the 2026 elections. The first round of voting is scheduled for October 4, with 5,186,562 eligible voters and 18 available seats in the Chamber of Deputies.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest no DF testa Celina e Leandro Grass e Arruda a cinco dias do 1º turno

en.title: New Quaest survey in the Federal District tests Celina and Leandro Grass and Arruda five days before the first round
en.summary: A Quaest survey in the Federal District will measure voting intentions for governor and two Senate seats, with 1,104 voters interviewed between Friday and Monday. Results will be released Tuesday, five days before the first round of elections.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest em PE testa Raquel Lyra e João Campos a cinco dias do 1º turno

en.title: New Quaest survey in PE tests Raquel Lyra and João Campos five days before the first round
en.summary: A Quaest survey in Pernambuco will measure voting intentions for governor and two Senate seats, with 1,302 voters interviewed between Friday and Monday. Results will be released Tuesday, five days before the first round of elections.

stories.title: Governo Lula proíbe bets no país; saldo deve ser sacado até o dia 5 de outubro

en.title: Lula government bans betting in Brazil; balances must be withdrawn by October 5
en.summary: Brazil's government has announced a permanent prohibition on online betting platforms. President Lula signed official measures to combat online gambling and reduce household debt, with the finance minister characterizing betting as a public health problem.
